WORKING NOTES

- Keep the textured blue wall for a bold, graphic backdrop.
Try this: Keep the textured blue wall for graphic contrast.
IMAGE PROMPT
An original young woman with wavy, sun-kissed
blonde hair leans against a textured blue wall. She
wears a pale blue ribbed tank with a scalloped lace
neckline and lace trim at the hem. Multiple silver
necklaces hang at her chest, and a silver stud sits
at her ear. Low-rise faded denim jeans with
decorative pocket detailing and a studded belt
complete the look. Her expression is calm and
direct. Warm, natural daylight. Palette of powder
blue, faded denim, and soft cream lace. Nostalgic
and relaxed, in the style of a 1990s film portrait.
